description: Airbnb was founded in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has grown into a global community of over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2.5 billion guest arrivals in almost every country and region across the globe. It operates a global marketplace connecting guests with stays, experiences and services in over 220 countries and regions, with offerings expanded to include services and redesigned experiences launched in May 2025, and it focuses on five key stakeholders: its employees, shareholders, hosts, guests and the communities it serves. Key strategic priorities include making its service better, bringing Airbnb to more parts of the world and expanding what it offers.
